metadata.title: Network Wireless Access

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability enabling secure wireless connectivity for institutional users, devices, and visitors.

props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: Wireless LAN controllers, access points, and identity-aware wireless enforcement platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Network Wireless Access pattern defines a solution for secure wireless connectivity with explicit admission and context-aware enforcement.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Wireless authentication events, device posture signals, session state, and access logs.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Wireless access does not imply trust based on location and must be explicitly evaluated and enforced.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Wireless access is governed using identity-aware, policy-driven enforcement consistent with Zero Trust Networking guidance.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Wireless access considerations align with SP 800-46 guidance for secure access at the network edge.

metadata.remarks: Network Wireless Access defines how devices and users connect to the institutional network using wireless technologies. This pattern enforces explicit admission, authentication, and context evaluation while preventing implicit trust based on physical proximity. It does not define identity proofing, authorization policy, segmentation design, or resiliency mechanisms, which are handled by complementary Secure Identity and Secure Network patterns.

components.title: Wireless Admission
components.description: Controlled admission of devices and users onto the wireless network.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid or stolen credentials to gain unauthorized wireless access.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Identity-aware admission restricts wireless access to authorized entities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Authorize and manage wireless access connections.

components.title: Wireless Device Posture Evaluation
components.description: Assessment of device security posture and context prior to and during wireless access.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of trusted but compromised wireless endpoints.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Evaluation of device state reduces risk from compromised or non-compliant endpoints.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Authenticate users and validate contextual indicators for wireless access.

components.title: Wireless Access Enforcement
components.description: Enforcement and maintenance of approved wireless access states.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence through unauthorized modification of wireless access permissions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Continuous enforcement ensures wireless access states remain compliant.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Enforce approved access states and revoke wireless access upon violation.
